card.name: Small words before liver-related terms
card.fires_on: Short linking words or partial word pieces just before liver terms such as hepatic enzymes, hepatotoxicity or liver function abnormalities. Also fires on odd spots inside names and phone numbers.

modes.label: Linking words before liver terms
modes.description: Words like 'of', 'as' or 'e.g.,' right before liver-injury wording.
